rationale: The cellar motion sensor (SEN-D1) showed RSSI -83 dBm, below the -80 dBm threshold that causes intermittent disconnections and missed alerts. The customer confirmed the sensor sits behind thick concrete walls and is much farther from the second-floor base station than the working hallway sensor. Installing the RP-1 repeater resolved the issue, consistent with historical case H-01.

repair_steps: Confirm the RP-1 repeater is powered on and its status LED is solid green.
Verify the cellar motion sensor (SEN-D1) now shows RSSI above -80 dBm in Device Settings > Device Info.
Ask the customer to trigger the cellar sensor and confirm they receive a push notification within 5 seconds.
Monitor the sensor for 24 hours to ensure no further disconnections occur.
Document the case with root cause WEAK_SIGNAL and resolution RP-1 repeater installed.

results.text: Peripherals talk to the base station over a sub-GHz proprietary radio. Signal strength (RSSI) is shown in Device Settings > Device Info. Above -70 dBm is good, -70 to -80 dBm is acceptable, below -80 dBm causes intermittent disconnections, delayed notifications and choppy live view. Concrete walls, metal doors and fridges strongly attenuate the signal. Fix: move the device or base station, or install the official RP-1 repeater.
